trials.claimQuote: Build sleek forms, automate workflows, and collect unlimited data effortlessly.
trials.reasoning: The vendor promises unlimited responses and a buyer confirms unlimited forms and responses with one payment. The 50 MB limit is per uploaded file with no storage limit, so it does not materially limit total data collection.

exhibits.quote: Allow users to upload files with a limit of 50 MB per file, no storage limit.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows data collection is capped at 50 MB per file, contradicting the claim of unlimited data.

exhibits.quote: Forms can only be purchased in bulk quantities of 5.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows form creation is restricted to bulk purchases, undermining unlimited data collection.

exhibits.quote: Automate your workflows, collect unlimited responses, and save money compared to bloated and expensive alternatives.
exhibits.argument: Vendor's own homepage promises unlimited responses, directly supporting the claim of collecting unlimited data.

exhibits.quote: Unlimited forms and responses, one payment, no per-form pricing creeping up as we add clients.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms receiving unlimited forms and responses in practice with no per-form pricing increase.
